data.long_description:
Experience refined island living in this exceptional waterfront residence at Bay Villas, Dubai Islands. Designed to offer the perfect blend of privacy, elegance, and coastal serenity, this prestigious home features expansive indoor and outdoor spaces, sophisticated architecture, and breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf.

Nestled within one of Dubai's most sought-after island destinations, residents enjoy direct beach access, beautifully landscaped surroundings, and a lifestyle centered around relaxation and exclusivity. The community offers a harmonious balance between resort-style living and urban convenience, with easy connectivity to major destinations across the city.

An outstanding opportunity for discerning homeowners and investors seeking a premium waterfront address in a rapidly growing coastal destination.

Property Features

- 6 Bedrooms
- 13,647.35 Sq. Ft.
- Waterfront Location
- Private Beach Access
- Premium Island Community
- Luxury Finishes
- Landscaped Outdoor Areas
- High Investment Potential
